versions.none: No versions in this role yet.

styleguide.title: Styleguide
styleguide.rule: The living inventory of the design system. Screens take their primitives from here — a control that is not on this page does not go on any other.
styleguide.sampleBody: Body text carries the reading weight of every screen.
styleguide.hint: A hint sits under the control.
styleguide.iconsNote: Icons come from lucide — never from text glyphs.

data.statusHint: Statuses follow what has happened — a score, a slot, a release. This shows where the words have fallen behind the facts, without changing anything. Works whose status you set by hand are left out.
data.cardViewHint: What the card draws beside the title. The fields themselves are untouched either way — hiding a row only stops it being drawn.
data.showMetaStrip: Show the row of craft fields
data.exportHint: Every work as markdown — front matter, full bodies, scores, releases and notes. Readable without kilna.
data.backupHint: The whole workspace in one file, taken safely while the app is running.
data.restoreHint: To restore, close kilna and put the backup in place of that file.
data.mcpHint: kilna --mcp serves this workspace to an agent such as Claude Code over the Model Context Protocol: it can read your works, versions, scores and calendar, and propose a version, a score or a note — which you apply here, or don't. Register it with the command above.
data.mcpAfter: Proposals land in a chat named after the agent — on the work, or on nothing for a work it proposes — and the bell counts them.
data.importHint: Bring in works, drafts and scores from an earlier system. Titles already here are left alone, and so are titles you deleted here.
data.imported: Imported {{works}} works, {{versions}} drafts, {{scores}} scores. Skipped {{skipped}} already here.
data.importedLeftDeleted_one: Left {{count}} you had deleted where it was.
data.importedLeftDeleted_other: Left {{count}} you had deleted where they were.
data.logHint: What went wrong while nobody was looking — a file that could not be removed, a task that would not start. Attach it to a report.
data.importedMaterial: The register brought {{terms}} terms and named {{named}} works for its images; the bank brought {{notes}} ideas and phrases.

calendar.layoutPreview_other: {{count}} releases would land between {{from}} and {{to}}. Nothing is booked yet.

assistant.noChats: Ask from a work's card, or start one here about anything.

framing.hint: the cover constructor without words, in the clip's style
framing.noPictureBlock: The profile marks no block of a scene as the picture, so there is nothing to build the still around.

files.detachBody: The file is deleted from the workspace. It does not go to the trash, and undo cannot bring it back.
files.copiedIn: A file is copied into the workspace, so a backup carries it.
files.empty: No files yet. A cover shows on the card, in the catalogue and in the calendar.

notes.pick: Pick a note on the left
notes.emptyBody: Ideas, lore, references — anything worth keeping that is not a work yet.
notes.goneBody: It was deleted or became a work. The trash still has it.
notes.bodyPlaceholder: Write here. Markdown works: lists, links, - [ ] checkboxes.
notes.attachTitle: Which work is this note about?
notes.promoteHint: The note becomes a work: its text is the first version
notes.promoteBody: The text becomes the work's first {{role}}, and the note goes to the trash so the words live in one place. Undo takes it all back.
notes.promoteNoRole: This kind of work has no role a text can be kept in.
notes.promoteFailed: Could not make a work of the note.
notes.emptyForWork: No notes on this work yet. Write the first one below.
notes.tagNew: Enter adds it as a new tag
notes.toWorkTitle: Which work does this go into?
notes.linePlaceholder: A new line — Enter keeps it
notes.promoteBodyMaterial: The text becomes the work’s first {{role}}. The note stays in the bank, marked used, so it is not taken twice. Undo takes it all back.

styles.name: Name
styles.descriptionHint: What goes into a prompt, word for word.
styles.hintHint: What to look at when this is described — never part of a prompt.
styles.referenceHint: Drop pictures anywhere on the style, paste one with Ctrl+V, or add them from disk.
styles.notPictures: {{count}} file was not a picture and was left out.
styles.notPictures_other: {{count}} files were not pictures and were left out.
styles.emptyBody: A style is a part a picture prompt is built from — a look, a character, a place. Make one, drop the pictures in, and let the assistant describe it.
styles.noDictionary: This craft has no style dictionary
styles.noDictionaryBody: A profile names the types a style can be. Add some in Settings, and this screen fills up.
styles.pickBody: Pick the parts, in the order they matter. The first is the spine of the picture, the last is a detail.
styles.noneReadyBody: A style is offered here once it carries a description. Write one, or let the assistant describe it from its references.
styles.dropHint: Drop references here, paste a picture with Ctrl+V, or pick files.
styles.dropToMake: Let go to make a style of them
styles.nameMissing: A style needs a name. Until it has one, the last name stays.
styles.nameTaken: Another style of this type is called “{{name}}”. Until this one is called something else, its last name and type stay.
styles.goneBody: It was deleted, or the address is old. The trash may still have it.
styles.describeNeedsReferences: Add a picture first: the description is read off the references.
styles.whenHint: For whoever picks styles for a picture - the idea generator reads it. Not the steer: that is about how it is described.
styles.sampleHint: CSS for the sample on the card - for the eye only. On a picture the lettering is drawn from the description.
styles.colourHint: The one colour of this background, as #RRGGBB.
styles.slotsHint: Captions of the work and of the channel's card. A slot with nothing to say drops out of the prompt with its phrase in [brackets].
styles.slotFromChannel: The channel's card fills this one
styles.slotFromWork: Filled from the work's captions - or dropped when it has none
styles.retiredTitle: “{{type}}” is no longer made of styles.
styles.retiredBody: The styles of this type stay and still read; new ones are not made.
styles.canonStandsIn: A hero with a card in the canon needs no “{{type}}” style: the card's description is built from its facts. This type stays for heroes without one.
styles.brandNote: The channel's own - its mark, signature details, captions and palette - lives on the Channel card in the canon, not here.

editor.axesHint: Label and weight. Keys are fixed — past scores are stored under them, and renaming one would orphan its history.
editor.tiersHint: What a score licenses you to do, and the total it takes to get there.
editor.rhythmHint: How often releases go out. The auto-layout keeps this many days between them; leave it empty for no set pace.
editor.keysHint: Existing works keep the status and kind they already had, even if you edit the wording here.
editor.promptsHint: Each action is a short message with placeholders, a method the assistant is briefed with, and what the answer becomes. Keys are fixed once made.
editor.actionTemplateHint: Sent as the message, with {title}, {body}, {role:lyrics}, {scenes}, {scene} and {donor:lyrics} filled from the work. Keep it short; the method carries the how. A placeholder nothing fills is refused at save.
editor.actionMethodHint: How the action is done: the role the assistant takes, what it checks and in what order, the shape of the answer, what it must never say. Markdown; goes to the model as a system instruction.
editor.actionMethodPlaceholder:
# Role

# What to check

# Output

# Never write
editor.actionKeyTaken: An action with this key already exists.
editor.releaseFields: What a release goes out as
editor.releaseFieldsHint: The boxes a release of each kind is filled in with. Keys are fixed — a planned release stores what was written under them. A template fills the box from the work; it reads the same placeholders an action does.
editor.fieldHint: A line under the box, optional
editor.fieldTemplate: Filled from the work, e.g. {title}. Leave empty to type it by hand every time.
editor.producesComment: A comment read off a screenshot
editor.madeTitle: Title of a work made from another
editor.madeTitleHint: {title} is the source's title, {n} its number. Leave empty to keep the source's title as it is.
editor.madeTitleNoTitle: The title never reads {title}, so every work made this way would be named the same.
editor.madeTitleUnknown: {{name}} is not filled here: a made title reads {title} and {n}.
editor.coverFormatsHint: The shape of the picture a release of each kind goes out with, width to height: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1. Leave empty for no picture of its own.
editor.coverFormatInvalid: Two whole numbers above zero with a colon between them, like 16:9.
editor.frameLine: Works of this kind play under a frame for their whole length: a still picture and the loop of what moves in it.
editor.coverLine: Works of this kind go out under a cover built in the constructor: a picture, a negative and a title, written from what is chosen.

error.database: The workspace database refused that. Nothing was changed.
error.io: Could not reach the workspace on disk.
error.schemaTooNew: This workspace was written by a newer version of kilna. Update the app to open it.
error.notFound: That is not here any more — it was probably deleted in another view.
error.assistant: The assistant could not be reached. Check that Claude Code is installed and on your PATH.
error.notRestorable: The work this belonged to is in the trash too. Restore that first.
error.layoutStale: The calendar changed since this preview was drawn. Lay the queue out again.
error.alreadyRunning: That is already running. Wait for it to finish.
error.busy: Several runs are already going. Wait for one to finish, or stop one.
error.frozen: That version was scored, so it stays as it was. Start the next revision instead.
error.internal: Something inside kilna went wrong. The detail is in the log.

crash.title: This screen stopped working
crash.body: The rest of the app is fine. Try again — if it keeps happening, the detail below is worth reporting.

toast.layoutFailed: Could not lay the queue out
toast.versionDerived: The text is in the editor. Saving makes it the next revision.
toast.tierUnpinned: The score has its say again
toast.sweepFailed: Could not check this week's releases.

trash.emptyBody_one: {{count}} entry will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
